THE ASSUMPTIONS, IN THE OPEN

Real sessions. A modeled alternative.

01

Your energy stays your energy.

Each row uses kwh_used as grid energy. kwh_added and battery percentages are shown as recorded. No vehicle capacity or extra efficiency loss is assumed.

02

The window matters.

Each row is replayed independently. Charging timestamps are interpreted in America/Chicago and rounded outward to five-minute boundaries. They are charging events, not verified plug-in or unplug times. The morning scenario extends availability to the chosen hour, caps the extension at the next recorded session, and always keeps the original window.

03

Standard versus time-of-day.

The baseline charges immediately on standard delivery. SPARC and the alternative plans default to time-of-day delivery. Savings include both rate and timing changes, with the same grid energy, power, and available window. Selecting standard for the plans isolates timing savings. Savings count only when both finish. The study’s fixed rates apply across all dates; flat bill charges and capacity charges are excluded.

04

Recorded does not mean metered detail.

The recorded-pattern estimate spreads grid energy evenly over each recorded window; the CSV has no interval power trace. Logged CSV cost is shown separately and is not the savings baseline. Peak power below the energy-implied average is raised and flagged. Missing prices and ambiguous daylight-saving timestamps are skipped.
